name: curlsmith
description: Firefox-first local API capture and styled cURL generator extension.

scripts.check:syntax: find extension -name '*.js' -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 node --check && node --check extension/test/integration/server.mjs && find scripts -name '*.mjs' -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 node --check
scripts.package:extension: mkdir -p web-ext-artifacts && rm -f "web-ext-artifacts/curlsmith-$npm_package_version.zip" && cd extension && zip -qr "../web-ext-artifacts/curlsmith-$npm_package_version.zip" . -x 'test/*' 'docs/*' '.webextensionignore' '.web-extension-id' '.DS_Store' '*/.DS_Store'
scripts.check: npm test && npm run check:syntax && npm run lint:addons && npm run audit:runtime
